name: Storm-Reaver Helmet
description: A savage-looking helmet forged from jagged iron and dragon-bone.

name: Storm-Reaver Harness
description: A brutal chestplate of overlapping iron plates, showing the scars of many battles.

description: Heavy iron bracers that add weight and power to every swing.

description: Thick iron greaves designed for stomping through the blood of fallen foes.
